_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER

Part of #34770, part 1 of 3: `objectstack-ui` only. The card stays open for the other skills; this PR carries no closing keyword.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 从 15,704 字节 / 304 行降到 8,974 字节 / 164 行,只留三样:动手前的四项检查、七条「能过 schema、运行时才出错」的陷阱(五条列在 Traps 下,另两条放在云端按标题读取的 `List Views` 和 `Actions` 两节里)、一张「做什么就打开哪个文件」的路由表。搬走的文字落进 `rules/` 下已有的四个文件(大段原样搬,个别表格压成一句),没有新增文件,没有删掉任何一条教学。第二轮另改一句:运行环境 `GET /api/v1/meta/types` 给出的是解析后的形状,不是书写用的契约。第三轮按评审改了五处小错:`separator` 不带 `label` / `icon`;`os validate` 其实拦得住一条陷阱;从 main 漏掉的两个短语补回;路由表里表单宽度一项归到表单那一行;changeset 里旧锚点的去向写对。
- **为什么改**:裁决记录 6943107981 的 S3 = A 定了目标:入口文件是路由器(6–9 KB,最多 500 行),键表和选项表指向契约而不是再抄一遍。AI 每次加载这个 skill 都要读完入口文件,入口越短,越早读到真正相关的那份规则。
- **风险与回滚**:风险在「搬家后 AI 找不到」。第一轮实测同一模型前后各跑一轮 32 个用例:带 skill 26/32 → 26/32,没有变差;第二轮调整了结构(两条陷阱挪到各自标题下),没有重跑,见 Tests。每个用例的答案所在文件都能从路由表走到(见下表,已按最终 head 重算)。云端按标题原文读取本 skill 的三节(triage 读数 6966635524),三个标题在本 head 各恰好出现一次,见 Acceptance notes 第 1 条。与另一张在途 PR #35087 在门禁脚本的 `rules/actions.md` 那一行有文本冲突(两边都改同一行上限),后合并的一方需按实测重写该行。回滚 = revert 这一个 PR,只涉及文档和一个门禁脚本里的数字。
- **先看**:① `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`(整篇重写,重点看 Traps 五条加 `List Views`、`Actions` 两节是否够用、是否有该留没留的);② `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` 末尾新增的 Form Views / Master-Detail Forms / Field Conditional Rules 三节(从入口文件原样搬来);③ `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 的六行 objectstack-ui 上限(四行因接收搬入文字而上调,两行下调)。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期末行 `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 58 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`,其中 `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 一行读作 2239 / 2239。
- **需要你做的**:合并。云端标题读取的核对结果已有(triage 读数 6966635524:云端读本 skill 三节,三个标题在本 head 各恰好出现一次,见 Acceptance notes 第 1 条和 Seat rulings);landing tier 实测为 H(人合):`skills/**` 六个文件命中受管面;低风险 skills 放权臂不适用,因为 diff 含门禁脚本 `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,它不在该臂的允许名单内。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` becomes a router. Frontmatter (lines 1–25, `description` included) is byte-identical to main.

- **First checks (4).** The installed `@objectstack/spec` version against the skill's `compatibility` line; the object's declaration and the project's own files; the type's contract (`references/_index.md` → the Zod source under `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/src/`, which decides what to write; a running environment serves the parsed shape as JSON Schema at `GET /api/v1/meta/types`, `entries[].schema`, where a defaulted key reads as required and a bare-string predicate as `{}`); `os validate` before reporting done.
- **Traps (7), each parses and then fails at run time.** Five are listed under Traps: a long form stays `simple`; a record with its line items is `inlineEdit` on the child's `master_detail` field, and `enable.apiMethods` must list `'bulk'`; a persisted chart binds a declared dataset; a filter token is presentation scope, not security; the object declares its record page. Two sit under the headings the cloud serves: keep the view kind the request names (`### List Views`, with the nine kinds), and an operation is an `action` whose write button must call the API (`## Actions`).
- **Where to go.** One table: what is being authored, the file it lives in, the rules file to open.
- **Three enumerations stay inline**, under their exact headings: `### Navigation Item Types`, `### Action Types`, `## Report Types`. `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` binds each to this file by heading, and that script is outside this part's file surface.
- **Two sections the hosted cloud serves by exact heading keep real content**: `### List Views` and `## Actions`, at the heading levels main has. Round 2 put them back; see Acceptance note 1.

Text that left `SKILL.md` landed in files that already existed:

| `rules/navigation.md` | 8,727 → 10,255 | `App.create` / `defineStack({ apps })`, the one-App-per-package paragraph, each item type's keys (`label` and `icon` on all but `separator`) with the `componentRef` registry-key gloss, `requiresObject` / `requiresService`, the `AppContextSelector` note |
| `rules/actions.md` | 11,231 → 12,123 | What an action is and where it registers; why a record button needs a placement and a `js` body with `api.write`; a bare field ref in `visible` or `disabled` fails `os validate`; a parameterized bulk mutation is `script` |
| `rules/dashboards.md` | 24,928 → 25,094 | An omitted widget `layout` auto-flows; `position` is not a widget key; a widget binding that resolves to nothing declared fails `os validate` |
| `rules/pages.md` | 22,663 → 22,644 | The relative-date pointer names objectstack-query `rules/filters.md` in place of a `SKILL.md` anchor that no longer exists |

## Tests

### Skill evals, before and after, same model

Runner `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals`, `--skills objectstack-ui --concurrency 4`, both arms, one repetition, the login's default model (the same served model in both rounds, read from each round's `round.json`).

| Round | Tree | Turns | with-skill | no-skill |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Before | main at `367e324eeb` | 64 of 64 | **26/32 (81%)** | 4/32 (13%) |
| After | this branch at `999673c9f0` (round 1's router) | 64 of 64 | **26/32 (81%)** | 4/32 (13%) |

Five with-skill cases fail in both rounds: `analytics-inline-vs-dataset#2`, `record-page#2`, `record-page#3`, `views-apps-actions-pages#4`, `views-apps-actions-pages#16`. Two flipped, one each way:

- `views-apps-actions-pages#9`: fail → pass. Before, the answer carried the forbidden `disabledMessage` / `disabledTooltip`.
- `views-apps-actions-pages#8`: pass → fail. The after answer uses the right form (`'Lead {{ record.name }} reassigned'`) and then quotes the forbidden `${record.name}` inside a sentence telling the reader not to write it. The grader matches literal substrings, so the warning sentence fails the case. The rule it rests on is in `rules/actions.md`, which this PR did not change there.

One repetition per round, so a one-case move in either direction is inside the noise this run can see. The count is not lower than before.

Both rounds used the runner and the case set of the branch point. #35022 landed on main after they ran: it adds a sentence to four ui prompts, loosens the tokens of `views-apps-actions-pages#16`, adds `triggers.json` (cases that grade the `description`, which this PR does not touch) and changes the runner. A pair of rounds on that newer runner and case set is NOT MEASURED: a new before-round needs main's skill tree in place of this branch's, and the comparison above already holds runner, cases and model constant on both sides. The deterministic check below was redone on the newer case set.

**The final head is only PARTLY MEASURED on the runner.** The fresh pair is in PR comment 6967475147. Its AFTER round stopped at 32 of 71 turns on the runner's rate-limit guard, so all 19 `views-apps-actions-pages` cases (the ones this restructure touches most) are NOT MEASURED. Full numbers and the not-measured list are in that comment. After the pair above, round 2 changed `SKILL.md` again at `32fa1759a0`: one sentence of first check 3, the view-kind and write-button traps moved under `### List Views` and `## Actions` (below the routing table), the nine kinds came back inline, and four short restatements moved to rules files. No rule left the bundle, and the deterministic check below was redone at the final head. Round 3 at `7fe6fb7ade` changed one sentence of first check 4, two routing rows, and wording in `rules/navigation.md` and `rules/actions.md`.

## Acceptance notes

1. **The cloud reads three sections of this skill by exact heading text; all three are in place.** Triage's reading 6966635524 on this PR (cloud main `aa67666f9`, `packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/published-refs.ts`): the cloud serves `List Views` and `Actions` from `SKILL.md` and `Adding a board, calendar, gallery or gantt beside the list` from `rules/list-views.md`, and its module load throws unless each heading occurs exactly once in its file. Round 1 had moved `List Views` out; round 2 keeps it as `### List Views` with the nine kinds and the keep-the-kind rule, and puts the write-button rule directly under `## Actions` so that section has text of its own above the Action Types table. Each heading is at the level main has it, and each count is 1 at `7fe6fb7ade` (outputs in Verification). The cloud repository itself is still unreadable from this session; the reading is triage's. Other headings that left `SKILL.md` and that the reading does not name: `### Form Views`, `### Master-Detail Forms (parent + child line items)`, `### Field Conditional Rules in Forms`, `## Detailed Rules`, `## CRM UI Blueprint (Metadata-First)`, `## Date Macros — Filter Placeholders`, `## Common Pitfalls`, `## Verify your work`, `## References`.
2. **The catalog total is nearly flat (−149 bytes).** The card's budget is on `SKILL.md`; this part moved text behind the router and did not delete teaching, so the catalog does not shrink.
3. **`SKILL.md` is 8,974 bytes, at the top of the 6–9 KB band, with its ratchet row never raised after round 1 (2241 → 2240 → 2239).** About 1.9 KB of it is the three bound enumeration tables and about 1.9 KB the two cloud-served sections. Moving the tables to `rules/` needs the `file` of three bindings in `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` re-pointed, which is outside this part's surface; `### Action Types` sits inside the cloud-served `## Actions` section.
4. **Forms did not get a file of their own.** A new `rules/forms.md` needs a new ratchet row, which the ratchet marks maintainer-only; the form text went to `rules/list-views.md`, the file that already teaches the `defineView` container. If a separate file is wanted, it is a follow-up with that row.
5. **Old anchors.** `SKILL.md#date-macros--filter-placeholders`, `#master-detail-forms-parent--child-line-items`, `#form-views`, `#common-pitfalls` and `#verify-your-work` no longer exist; `#view-types`, `#list-views` and `#actions` do. The one in-repo link to a removed anchor (`rules/pages.md`) is re-pointed; `check:skill-links` and `check:doc-anchors` read the tree.
6. **Overlap, earlier.** #35022 edited `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/*` and landed while this was in progress; this PR touches no file there and main merged in without conflict. `overlap-check` against main and the open PR heads sharing a file (#35038, #33849): clean (see Verification).
7. **Overlap with #35087 (open, draft).** It adds teaching to `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` and moves that file's ratchet row; `overlap-check` at `7fe6fb7ade` reports a conflict in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (the file itself merges cleanly). Whichever of the two lands second rewrites the `rules/actions.md` row at its measurement. The round-3 commit was pushed with that verdict standing; the conflict comes from the row this PR has changed since round 1, not from round 3.

### Seat rulings on the open questions (seat 3, 2026-11-18 01:52Z)

- **Note 1 (cloud heading reads): route A.** The seat asked triage on #32588 for a reading from a seat with cloud access: which of the eleven moved headings the cloud reads, and from which file. That reading is a condition before merge, and the seat's L2 and Tier H record carry it. No stub headings go back into `SKILL.md` unless the reading names a heading the cloud uses.
- **Note 3 (bound enumeration tables): stay inline** in this part.
- **Note 4 (forms): taught in `rules/list-views.md`**, no new `rules/forms.md`.
- **Evals.** At 01:52Z the seat accepted the round 1 pair (26/32 before and after, on the runner and case set from before #35022). At 02:08Z the seat changed that ruling: a fresh pair on the final head is owed. The fresh pair is PR comment 6967475147, and it is partial. Its AFTER round stopped at 32 of 71 turns on the runner's rate-limit guard, so the 19 `views-apps-actions-pages` cases are NOT MEASURED at `7fe6fb7ade`.

## Verification

The sentence now reads "`label`, `icon` on all but `separator`"; paid inside the file (10,256 → 10,255 bytes, row stays 2564).

- **N2**, `rules/actions.md`: the bare-field-ref sentence sits on the `disabled` bullet and covers `visible` and `disabled`; "A parameterized bulk mutation is `script`" is back. Paid inside the file (12,126 → 12,123 bytes).
- **N3**, the changeset: `#common-pitfalls` points at `rules/list-views.md` (Column Features) and `rules/dashboards.md`.
- **N4**, the routing table: form width, columns and `sections` are on the Form Views row.
